question: Which is a saltwater lake located in the Tibet Autonomous Region, China, to the west of Lake Mansarovar and to the south of Mount Kailash?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lake Rakshastal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points

__
 
• **Lake Rakshastal is a saltwater lake **in Tibet Autonomous Region, China.

 
 
• Located to the west of** Lake Mansarovar and south of Mount Kailash.**** **
 
 
 
• According to Hindu mythology, **Ravana**, the demon-like King of Lanka, performed severe penance here to please **Lord Shiva**.
 
 
• The lake is also known as **Ravan Tal**.
 
 
 
• A short river named **Ganga Chhu** connects Lake Mansarovar with Rakshastal.
 
• Rakshastal covers an area of **250 square kilometers**.
 
 
• Its surroundings include **white cobbles**, hills, and a **dark red island**.
 
 
 
• Lake Rakshastal remains an integral part of the **Kailash-Manasarovar pilgrimage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lake Yamdrok Tso**__

 __
 
• **​**__Yamdrok Lake, also known as **Yamdrok Yumtso**, is sacred in Tibetan tradition.
 
• The lake lies to the **west of Lake Mansarovar** and to the **south of Mount Kailash**.
 
• It is one of the **three largest lakes in Tibet**, stretching over **72 km (45 mi)**. 
 __
 
• ​The lake is fan-shaped, spreading southward and narrowing to the north.
 
 
 
• Yamdrok Lake is surrounded by **snow-capped mountains** and fed by numerous small streams.
 
 
 
• **Lake Rawok**__ ​
 __
 
• Lake Rawok Tso, also known as **Rawok Lake**, is the **largest lake in eastern Tibet**.
 
• It is located in **Pasho County** within the **Chamdo prefecture**.
 
• Lake Rawok sits at an **altitude of 3,800 meters**.
 
• Surrounded by magnificent snow-capped mountains and lush forests, Rawok Lake offers breathtaking views.
 
 
 
• **Lake Basum Tso**__
 
 
• Lake Basum Tso, also known as **Basumtso Lake, is the lake in eastern Tibet.​**
 
• The lake is **surrounded by snow-capped peaks** and **natural forests**.
 
• It is not only a visual delight but also a **holy lake** for the **Nyingma sect** of Tibetan Buddhism
